T: We scare because we care. We cook because we're hungry.
D: Two monsters accidentally let a little girl into their world.
P: Serve the sushi when Mike takes Celia to the sushi place.
S: Mike and Celia's date at the sushi restaurant

s.note: Mike and Celia's date at the sushi restaurant
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, lay 200g sliced salmon, avocado and cucumber along each and roll tight. Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.

s.note: the abominable snowman offers them in the Himalayas
s.how: Simmer 150g caster sugar with 150ml water and the juice and zest of 3 lemons for 5 minutes, then chill. Crush or shave 1kg ice, pack it into 4 cups and pour the lemon syrup over the top. Eat fast before it melts.

m.note: for the scarers after a shift
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 60ml soy, 60ml mirin, 2 tbsp sake and 2 tbsp sugar for an hour. Grill until charred, then reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and steamed bok choy.

w.note: all those doors on the scare floor
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 80g sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 180g plain flour. Roll into 20 balls, press a hole with a thumb, fill with raspberry jam and bake at 180C for 14 minutes.

d.how: Blend 600ml pineapple juice with the juice of 2 lemons and 4 cups of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into four clear glasses and serve straight away with spoon straws.
